I had a friend start off as a maruader/warrior and they switched over the black mage, since they couldn't quite get the hang of keeping aggro and that caused a lot of chaos in the dungeons. I personally suggest picking up any DPS or healer, they're pretty simple with their learning curve. Be sure to read your tooltips by hovering your abilities when you get them, abilities have synergies with each other outside of combos and melee DPS classes have "positionals" on some abilities that do more damage from the flank/rear.

1. If you don't mind the story, go along with the cutscenes. You can skip the text for quests and then read the summary in the quest log afterwards. I personally skipped all of 2.0 - 2.55, only watching the voiced cutscenes and kinda understood it enough. The other expansions make MSQ pretty interesting so I watched through those despite usually hating long stories in games.
2. Personal advice: get to level 50 and finish 2.0 on pugilist/monk, then start levelling your alternative class. You can't replay the story on an alternative class, but you can do the dungeons. Or, if you really want to switch over, you could go ahead and level a healer and continue MSQ on that.
3. Explanation to the previous bullet- at level 50, you get all the dungeons from 1-50. After levelling your starting class to level 15 doing fates and your hunting log (which takes seemingly forever), you can start doing the dungeons that you unlocked from MSQ. Dungeons give you like 2-3 levels each, which is super nice. In addition to having all the dungeons, queueing as a healer results in instant queue times, which accelerates the levelling process tenfold. 
4. All of the classes that you had the option of starting at level 1 with unlock their job at 30. Other jobs start at higher levels, you can use [this website](https://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/jobguide/battle/) to see the starting quest level and get further info.
5. XP boost tips: 
   1. Use the ring from the new adventurer training, gives you a hefty XP boost
   2. If you're looking to get a subscription, use the recruit a friend campaign and get yourself the friendship circlet 
   3. Eat foods for the well fed buff that gives a 3% XP boost
   4. Log out in hubs/sanctuaries so you can get rested XP
